Medieval Alchemists History for Sleep 🌙 Until Grey Light at the Door

About 1 hour 48 min · Released Mon 16 Nov 2026 · Updated 18 Nov 2026 · narrated slowly for sleep

Watch on YouTube Listen on YouTube Music

Medieval Alchemists history for sleep: a small workshop lane on the Left Bank of Paris, autumn 1400, in the reign of Charles VI

On a quiet night the safest heat in a workshop was not the open flame but a pot of hot water, a bath later called Mary's, after an ancient maker of stills who wanted the work warmed evenly and not scorched. I'll walk with you through one such night in a small Paris lane, from the evening bells toward first light. We'll stay with the glass, the notebook, and the slow habits of people trying to understand metals, medicines, and the world.

🌙 No mid-video ads, nothing to wake you.

The places, the road and the way of life are real. The people we follow tonight are imagined.
